newsitem.title: USA: Workgroup warns of loss, stock plunges.
newsitem.headline: Workgroup warns of loss, stock plunges.

text.p: Workgroup Technology Corp., a provider of product data management systems, Friday warned that it might report a loss for at least one quarter, sparking a sharp sell-off that cut the value of its stock by more than half.
The stock fell $7.75 to $7.25 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
Alex. Brown, which had previously recommended buying the stock, downgraded it to neutral.
Workgroup said it expected revenues for the second quarter and the rest of the year to fall below analysts' estimates, resulting in a net loss for at least that quarter.
Additional expenses related to the formation of a new development unit, however, along with the revenue drop, could lead to net losses for the third and fourth quarters as well, it said.

Workgroup attributed the low revenues to the disappointing performance of its European operations, which were started last year, the delay until the fourth quarter in the delivery of a version of its server product for Microsoft Corp.'s Windows NT operating system, and delays in the closing of several significant orders.
